text:
maria: Quick question — when users save a per-route filter in Console, should the saved query also store the telemetry sampling config (sample rate + strata)? We have customers expecting exact reproduction of graphs when they re-open.

liam: I think yes for UX parity with 'snapshot' use cases. But storing sampling config could change cost/quota semantics.

ayana: +1 for storing sampling meta but not the actual sampling seed. Store a 'telemetry_profile_id' that references a server-side config instead of embedding full rules.

sara: dev note: referencing profile id means we need server API: POST /v1/telemetry-profiles -> id. Do we have that? Not yet.

rahul: we can reuse existing sampling configs from ingestion. But tying to saved query might require migration across orgs/teams — need scoping rules.

maria: We also need to decide if saved queries include routing hints (model, region, tier). Some customers want the exact model pinned for cost/quality comparisons.

liam: prefer pinning the model version; region should be a suggestion only. If region pinned and not available, fallback to routing policy.

ayana: UX suggestion: save dialog has a small checkbox: 'Include telemetry profile & model pins' with help text 'Pins ensure reproducible results but may increase quota usage'. Default: off for orgs flagged as quota-constrained.

sara: backend note: even if default is off, we should record 'what was available at save time' (model id + telemetry_profile_id) so the UI can show a diff later.

rahul: security: telemetry profiles may reference sensitive bucket names or internal metrics. Ensure telemetry_profile_id is scoped to org and no public exposure.

maria: Action items: sara to draft API proposal for telemetry-profile CRUD and attach-to-savedquery (ETA Fri), liam to mock save dialog copy, ayana to prototype the 'pin unavailable' fallback confirmation flow.

liam: one more: should saved queries store an immutable 'effective routing snapshot' vs a dynamic 'routing_policy_ref'? I vote for immutable snapshot for reproducibility, with a warning that it may be stale.

ayana: +1 but store both: an immutable snapshot for exact replays and a ref for upgrades. UI can surface a 'stale' badge and offer to rebind.

devops-bot: deploy: savedqueries-service v2 scheduled for canary on staging at 1736012390.

maria: perfect — dropping markers here. thanks all. :thumbsup:
